footer.tagline: A considered digital space for learners, individuals and small enterprises seeking a distinctive online presence.

hero.title: Learn programming in small steps.
hero.description: Each lesson is a short session with concepts, practice, and instant feedback. Complete lessons in order to unlock the next stage.

path.title: Your journey
path.description: Learn in order, practice immediately, and unlock each milestone.

sync.passDescription: Verify the result and save progress

quality.title: Quality is more than a promise.
quality.description: Study with Hugo checks the real structure of every lesson: learning goals, linked practice, and assessment rules. The figures below are calculated from the live curriculum.

goal.title: Goals that can be verified
goal.description: Every lesson states what learners should understand and be able to build.

sync.title: Lessons and assignments share one topic
sync.description: Practice comes directly from the lesson, without unrelated or out-of-scope questions.

feedback.title: Feedback immediately after practice
feedback.description: The system checks code, answers, or submitted work so learners can improve straight away.

evidence.title: Progress is recorded after requirements are met
evidence.description: A lesson is completed only when its own assessment conditions are satisfied.

quality.note: The Hugo Studio Original mark identifies core content authored exclusively for this learning path. External references, when used, are credited separately.

resources.title: Learning resources
resources.description: Videos and academic references organized by learning stage.

offline.body: Check Wi-Fi or mobile data. The page reconnects on its own once you're back online.
